title: Addressable: Regular Expression Denial of Service in templates with multiple variables (CVE-2026-126352)
description: Addressable versions 2.3.0 through 2.9.0 contain a Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) vulnerability in the URI template matching implementation. Templates with multiple variables in one expression or several single-variable expressions can cause excessive backtracking when matching maliciously crafted URIs, leading to high CPU consumption and denial of service. This affects Ruby implementations with backtracking regex engines such as MRI Ruby < 3.3, JRuby, and TruffleRuby 40.0. The issue is fixed in Addressable 2.9.1 and mitigated in MRI Ruby 3.3 and later.
